init.title: KR Survival Kit Settings
init.description: You can change these settings anytime after installation. Household name, dashboard title, and visible sections can be customized from the ⚙️ button at the top right of the dashboard.

data.mqtt_enabled: Publish alert counts to MQTT (optional, advanced)

data_description.household_size: Enter 1 to 99 people. Changing this immediately recalculates water/food survival days and recommended target quantities.
data_description.inspection_days: Enter 7 to 365 days. Items not verified (saved) within this period are marked as 'Check Needed'. Custom per-item intervals are preserved.
data_description.mqtt_enabled: Most users can leave this off. This integration already creates 3 Home Assistant sensors (shortage, needs check, expiring) for automations and alerts. Enable this only if you want to read those 3 counts in external tools or displays via MQTT. It publishes only the 3 counts every minute (never item names, quantities, or locations) and requires an MQTT broker integration.

error.save_failed: Could not save household settings. Please try again shortly.

abort.not_loaded: KR Survival Kit is not loaded yet. Restart Home Assistant and try again.

user.title: KR Survival Kit
user.description: Track quantities and expiration dates of household emergency supplies such as drinking water and food. Data is stored locally in Home Assistant, and shortages or items needing review appear on your dashboard.

data_description.household_size: Enter the number of people in your household (1–99). Defaults to 4 and sets baseline targets for water, backpacks, and blankets.
data_description.inspection_days: Enter 7 to 365 days (default: 90 days / ~3 months). Items not verified within this interval will be flagged for review. This is separate from product expiration dates and can be overridden per item on the card.

abort.already_configured: KR Survival Kit is already configured.
abort.incomplete_install: Installation files are missing or corrupted. Reinstall the full integration folder from GitHub and restart Home Assistant.
